title: Checkout 502s during flash-sale traffic
query: Flash-sale traffic spike: checkout endpoint returning HTTP 502 for about 8 minutes, and the app log shows Postgres connection pool exhausted with max_connections=20 reached.

title: Mobile 401 spike after a key rotation
query: Mobile clients suddenly getting a wave of 401 Unauthorized errors right after a JWT signing key rotation. Error log says signature verification failed.
